learning_outcomes.text: Explains the fundamental building blocks of deep learning.
Develops simple artificial neural network models with Python.
Creates and trains models using TensorFlow and Keras libraries.
Understands and applies common architectures such as CNN and RNN.
Solves classification and regression problems by working with real datasets.
Applies model evaluation and improvement methods.
Analyzes and interprets the decision-making processes of deep learning models.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to deep learning and its history
Concepts of training, validation, and testing
Model creation and training with Keras-1
Model creation and training with Keras-2
Ethics in deep learning and AI security
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exams are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.

Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville, Deep Learning, MIT Press, 2016
